This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Let me know if you give it a go 😄 Chris x CREAM CHEESE CHICKEN | Serves 4 INGREDIENTS ➡️CHICKEN: 2x 250g/9oz Chicken Breasts, brought close to room temp 1/2 tsp EACH: Smoked Paprika, Salt 1/4 tsp EACH: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Dried Oregano, Black Pepper, plus more to serve 1/8 tsp Dried Thyme 1 tbsp EACH: Unsalted Butter, Olive Oil ➡️SAUCE: 2 Shallots, very finely diced 180ml / 3/4 cup Chicken Stock (use low-salt if sensitive to salt) 1x 165g/5.8oz tub of full-fat Cream Cheese, brought close to room temp (I use Philadelphia) 1 tsp Dijon Mustard finely diced Fresh Chives, to serve METHOD 1️⃣Horizontally slice each chicken breast right through the centre to create 4 even-sized breasts. Combine the seasoning mix in a small pot or bowl, then evenly sprinkle over both sides of each breast. 2️⃣Place a large pan over medium-high heat and stir in the butter and oil. Add the chicken and fry for a few minutes on each side, or until lightly charred on the outside and piping hot/white through the centre. Remove and place on a plate to one side then lower the heat to medium. 3️⃣Add the shallots and fry in the leftover fat until soft and golden. Pour in the stock, then stir in the cream cheese until it blends into a sauce. You'll need to give it a good whisk to smooth out all the small lumps. Stir in the dijon, then stir in the resting juices from the chicken. 4️⃣The sauce should be relatively thick already, but if it's not just gently simmer for a couple of minutes. If you over thicken it just stir in a splash more stock or water to thin it out. 5️⃣Add the chicken back in and baste in the sauce, then sprinkle with chives and a pinch of black pepper. Serve up and enjoy!

It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Arroz con Pollo (ACP) 🧀🍗 This is easily one of our FAVORITE family dinners. It’s the version of arroz con pollo I always ordered at Mexican restaurants when I lived in Virginia: Mexican rice, seasoned chicken, and an absolutely unreasonable amount of queso. 😂 I couldn’t find it prepared this way after moving to Washington, so eventually I learned to make it myself. Now it’s on our table at least once a month! For the rice: • 1 batch Mexican restaurant-style rice 👉 I use the recipe from @jessvesco. I tried SO many recipes before finding this one, and her method works perfectly for me every single time! For the chicken: • 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, thinly sliced • 2 Tbsp oil • 2 Tbsp water • 1 batch homemade fajita seasoning Fajita seasoning: • ½ Tbsp chili powder • ½ Tbsp ground cumin • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • ½ tsp dried oregano • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp ground black pepper For the queso: • 1½ lbs white American cheese, from the deli counter • 8 oz pepper jack cheese • 2 cups milk Directions: Prepare your Mexican rice according to your favorite recipe. Toss the sliced chicken thighs with the oil, water and fajita seasoning. Cook the chicken in batches over high heat until cooked through with plenty of browned, slightly crispy edges. Avoid overcrowding the pan so the chicken sears instead of steaming. For the queso, combine the white American cheese, pepper jack and milk over low heat. Stir frequently and melt everything together slowly until completely smooth and creamy. No roux needed! To serve, start with a generous bed of Mexican rice, pile on the chicken, and smother the entire situation in queso. This one takes a little more time (and a LOT more cheese) than most of my weeknight dinners, but it’s still cheaper than taking a family of four out to eat. And there are NEVER complaints when ACP is for dinner. 😂 #ArrozConPollo #ACP #ChickenAndRice #MexicanRestaurantStyle #FamilyDinner #DinnerIdeas #RealisticDinners #ChickenRecipes #ComfortFood #WhatsForDinner

For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3.
